name: uci-playing-pilot-v1
question: What game strength does the frozen Searched Locked-3 policy exhibit under a reproducible UCI match protocol?
candidate: Frozen May Searched Locked-3: all legal root moves, two forcing plies, 128 children per root candidate, lexical UCI ties
opponents: Stockfish 18 with Threads 1, Hash 16 MB, and 100 nodes per move

openings.pairing: Each opening is played twice per opponent with candidate colors reversed

resources.candidate: Fixed deterministic policy computation; UCI go arguments do not alter search
resources.static_baselines: One static evaluation per legal root move

forfeits: Engine exception, timeout, null move in a live position, or illegal move loses immediately.
metrics: engine-pool logistic Elo difference and interval
candidate and opponent move time and reported nodes
termination reasons, illegal moves, crashes, and timeouts
decision: Protocol correctness requires zero candidate illegal moves, crashes, and timeouts. Strength has no pass threshold in this pilot.
guardrail: Engine-pool Elo differences are not human FIDE ratings and apply only to this opening/resource/opponent pool.
